# Benign recognition fixture

`astronaut.jpg` is a JPEG conversion (Pillow, quality 90) of the 512×512 NASA
photograph of Eileen Collins in scikit-image 0.24.0:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.24.0/skimage/data/astronaut.png

The [scikit-image documentation](https://scikit-image.org/docs/0.24.x/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut)
identifies the photograph as public domain, with no known copyright restrictions.
Original NASA collection: https://flic.kr/p/r9qvLn . This image is used only for
automated recognition tests and is not packaged in the app.
